title: 🌀 Pseudo-3D Spaces

accepted_baseline.label: Green Arch Passage direction + forward/back-only movement override
preserve: monumental scale through partial occlusion / out-of-frame height

current_candidate.summary: Spaces v9 adds a second brutalist cylinder map, fixes premature near-structure popping, removes the ambiguous map-1 far wall/ceiling read by dissolving the upper volume into darkness, and keeps forward/back-only movement.

open_feedback: Review Map 1 for natural disappearance: near ribs should persist until they are actually behind/out of view.
Review Map 1 upper volume: it should read as height disappearing into darkness, not as an unexplained background wall or fake ceiling.
Review Map 2 as a distinct brutalist hall: huge checker cylinders should feel taller than the frame and the floor should fade into darkness with distance.
Both maps must preserve fixed frontal view and forward/back-only movement.
